verdict.rationale: Evidence shows LM Studio exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API and a CLI (`lms`) for scripting and headless use, which lets developers build against it, but the pack contains no mention of dedicated official SDK packages (e.g., Python/JS client libraries) or SDK reference docs. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK libraries (language bindings), SDK usage docs/examples, and independent confirmation of SDK reliability beyond the raw REST/CLI interface.
